# Officine Allegra

> Officine Allegra is a Milan-based espresso machine workshop (Pantigliate, Italy) that designs and builds professional and domestic espresso machines in small batches — Italian craftsmanship combined with contemporary engineering. "A workshop, not a factory."

## About
- Company: Officine Allegra Srl
- Location: Viale G. di Vittorio 26, 20048 Pantigliate (MI), Italia
- Contact: info@officineallegra.com · +39 0373 635174
- Philosophy: precision-built, small-batch espresso machines. One DNA, multiple expressions. Design is never decoration — beauty comes from function.

## Professional machines
- [Dinamica](https://officineallegra.com/dinamica): Standard professional line. Compact (1GR) and Auto 2GR configurations. Engineering and aesthetics, in balance.

## Domestic
- Domestic espresso machine — coming 2026. Professional-grade engineering for the home.
